parsed.rationale: All 11 members are unnamed extensions (name is empty string) on `EnvironmentValues` spread across 5 distinct packages — `AppServices`, `Playback`, `WXUI`, `Wallpaper`, and `PlayerHeaderView`. In SwiftUI it is idiomatic and intentional to extend `EnvironmentValues` in each module that introduces a new environment key; each extension adds domain-specific keys (e.g., playlist service, review-request service, radio player controller, accent color) that belong to their respective packages. Consolidating these into a single location would create an undesirable cross-package dependency and violate the encapsulation each package currently enjoys. The structural signal here is purely coincidental: the shared name `EnvironmentValues` is a SwiftUI framework type, not a user-defined type, and the extensions are semantically unrelated.
